 Big 12 Announces Network, Kickoff Time for WVU Football vs. Houston
 Published
 10 hours ago on
 November 15, 2026 
 By
 Mike Asti 
 Kelsie LeRose / WVSN 
 1 share 
 Share 
 Tweet 
 Reddit 
 Comments 
 On Sunday, the Big 12 announced the network and kickoff time for the WVU football 2026 season home finale against Houston.
 West Virginia will host the Cougars at Milan Puskar Stadium at 1 pm ET and the game will air nationally on TNT. It will also simulcast on TruTV and HBO.
 The Mountaineers are coming off a 37-14 blowout loss at the hands of Kansas while Houston is looking to respond from their 42-32 upset loss to Colorado on Friday night.
 West Virginia needs to win one of their last two regular season games to reach bowl eligibility, entering their matchup with Houston at 5-5 (2-5, Big 12).
